app.title: Show HN: Build a PC in 3D in the Browser
app.description: A client‑side 3D model of a computer that can be assembled in the browser using WebGL/Three.js.
proposed_tests: Clone the repository and run the dev server.
Open the URL and verify the 3D scene loads without errors.
Use the build tool to export a production build and deploy to a static host.
Measure page load time and 3D frame rate.
Interact with the assembly UI and confirm state changes.
